items.headline: Singapore's BDx breaks ground on 640MW AI data centre in Indonesia, backed by $320m loan
items.summary: Singapore-based BDx has started construction on a 640 MW AI data centre in Indonesia. The company secured a US$320 million loan facility in 2026 to support the expansion into the region's biggest economy.
items.why_it_matters: The facility's scale and dedicated financing point to accelerating capital deployment into Southeast Asian AI infrastructure, with lenders increasingly financing data-centre build-outs directly.

items.headline: Korean wealth fund weighs sale of more than $1 billion of PE stakes, report says
items.summary: A South Korean wealth fund is weighing the sale of more than $1 billion of private equity stakes, according to a report. Further details of the fund's identity and the sale timeline were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: A sale of this size would rank among the larger LP-led secondaries transactions out of Asia this year, testing buyer appetite for large stake portfolios.

items.headline: Australian regulator warns private credit sector of more enforcement after Bathla's A$3.4bn collapse
items.summary: Australia's regulator warned the private credit sector to expect more enforcement action following the insolvency of Bathla. Bathla's A$3.4 billion in debt from 40 lenders was funnelled through around 542 special purpose vehicles.
items.why_it_matters: The scale of the SPV structure shows how opaque private credit financing has become, and a regulator signalling more enforcement raises compliance costs across the sector.

items.headline: Six lenders hold US$870 million exposure to iron-ore trader Radiant World, first public tally shows
items.summary: A newly disclosed table shows six lenders with a combined US$870 million exposure to iron-ore trader Radiant World. It is the first comprehensive public accounting of lenders' exposure to the company.
items.why_it_matters: The disclosure gives creditors and counterparties their first clear picture of concentration risk in a commodity-trading credit relationship that had previously been opaque.

items.headline: Alibaba targets AI model with up to 10 trillion parameters, sets 20GW data-centre capacity goal
items.summary: Alibaba said it is developing an AI model with 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters and unveiled a new chip. The company also set a target for Alibaba Cloud's global data-centre capacity to exceed 20 gigawatts by 2032.
items.why_it_matters: The capacity target signals a multi-year escalation in China's AI infrastructure build-out, with implications for chip supply chains and data-centre financing across the region.

items.headline: Safran opens US$22 million landing-gear MRO facility in Singapore
items.summary: Safran has launched a US$22 million landing-gear maintenance, repair and overhaul facility in Singapore. The site makes Singapore the aviation group's second-largest location globally for such services.
items.why_it_matters: The investment underscores Singapore's continued draw for aerospace-services capital even as the MRO sector consolidates around fewer, larger hubs.
